title: BudgetLimitReached
description: Payload of the run.budgetLimitReached notification: an analysis or repository-profiling run has hit one of its configured limits and is paused, waiting to be told whether to keep going. The renderer answers with run.answerBudgetPrompt naming promptId; the run stays paused on the host until it does, or until the request is cancelled some other way.

promptId.description: Identifies this one prompt. Echoed back on run.answerBudgetPrompt; naming an id that is no longer waiting is a no-op rather than an error, since a renderer racing a cancel against a click is expected.

explanation.description: The same sentence a hard stop would use, e.g. 'The run reached its limit of 500 tool calls.' Shown as the body of the prompt.

tokensUsed.description: Input plus output tokens spent so far, across the whole run.

turnsUsed.description: Round trips to the provider completed so far.

costUsd.description: Estimated cost in US dollars spent so far. Absent when the model has no entry in the price table — unknown is reported as unknown, never as zero.
